focal_length_equivalent_mm.rationale: Brief camera specification; not stated in capture guide.

equivalent_sensor_width_mm.rationale: Assume horizontal full-frame equivalence; actual phone calibration may differ.

overlap_target.rationale: Conservative margin above the guide requirement of more than half.

guide_overlap_floor.rationale: Overlap must be strictly greater than this fraction.

max_step_deg.rationale: Guide recommends frames every 10 to 15 degrees; tighter is allowed if needed.

radius_multipliers.rationale: Two radii per guide; outer-radius multiplier is an operator choice.

metres_per_extra_level.rationale: Add a height level for each additional size band; coverage heuristic, not a solve guarantee.

height_to_size_ratio.rationale: Assume height equals size when not measured.

framing_margin.rationale: Increase estimated framing distance for margin.

stations_per_minute.rationale: Includes pausing for one still per station; excludes setup, access and extra detail shots.

field_frame_range.rationale: Observed planning range, not a cap.

exposure_lock.value: Lock exposure and white balance within a pass when practical; keep lighting consistent.
exposure_lock.rationale: Guide leaves Smart HDR on and permits exposure drift; does not require a lock.

preserve_files.value: Keep original EXIF and uncropped full-resolution stills.
preserve_files.rationale: Requested file discipline; guide does not explicitly discuss EXIF or cropping.

scale_reference.value: Photograph a measured scale reference without touching historic fabric.
scale_reference.rationale: Guide does not specify scale capture.

provenance_evidence.value: Photograph identifying signage and a subject overview; record title and place, preserve dated originals.
provenance_evidence.rationale: Guide requires a generated provenance sheet but does not specify evidence photographs.

symmetry_policy.value: For symmetric subjects, inspect registration; compare an incremental mapper solve if global fails.
symmetry_policy.rationale: Guide gives no symmetry rule; incremental is a fallback experiment, not its recommendation.

interior_start.value: For interiors, start with a connected overview pass through the room and entrances before detail shots.
interior_start.rationale: Guide has no interior start recipe; proposed field approach requires validation.
